scope.market_definition: The global flexible packaging market encompasses the production and supply of flexible packaging materials and products—such as pouches, bags, films, and wraps—made from plastic, paper, aluminum foil, and multi-layer laminates. Participants include raw material suppliers, film and foil converters, packaging manufacturers, brand owners, and end-use industries like food and beverage, personal care, and pharmaceuticals. The market is global, with production and consumption across all regions, and is characterized by a diverse value chain from resin and substrate production to converting and printing.

value_chain_layers.description: Suppliers of base materials used in flexible packaging: polymer resins, plastic films (BOPP, BOPET, PE, PP), aluminum foil, paper, adhesives, coatings, and inks.

search_intents: polypropylene resin supplier for flexible packaging

value_chain_layers.description: Companies that convert raw materials into flexible packaging products through processes like extrusion, lamination, printing, slitting, and pouch making.
Suppliers of machinery used to fill, seal, and package products into flexible formats, including form-fill-seal machines, bagging machines, and automated packaging lines.

horizontal form fill seal machine manufacturer

value_chain_layers.description: Companies that purchase flexible packaging for their products, including food and beverage, personal care, pharmaceuticals, and industrial applications.
Providers of recyclable materials, compostable films, and recycling services for flexible packaging, addressing environmental regulations and brand sustainability goals.

in_scope: Flexible packaging converters (pouch, bag, film manufacturers)
Raw material suppliers (resins, films, foils, adhesives, inks)
Brand owners and end-users (food, beverage, personal care, pharma)
